title: Strong prompt, or wishful thinking?
intro: Fragments from feature and refactor prompts — sort the load-bearing ones from the vibes.

cards.text: "Modify _format_results in @backend/search_tools.py so lesson links are also returned"
"Current: 1 tool call, then tools are removed. Desired: each call a separate API round"
"Example flow: get course outline → use lesson 4's title → search → answer"
"Terminate when: 2 rounds done, no tool_use blocks, or a tool call fails"
"Match existing sections — same font size, color, uppercase formatting"
"Links embedded invisibly — no visible URL text"
"Improve the UI so it feels more modern"

debrief: Strong prompts do two jobs: they ANCHOR (exact files via @, current-versus-desired behavior, a worked example flow) and they DEFINE DONE (styling constraints, invisible-embed rules, explicit termination conditions). The vibes bucket fails both — 'smarter' and 'more modern' give the model nothing to aim at and you nothing to verify against. The tell: could Playwright or a test check it? If nothing could ever verify the ask, it isn't an ask yet.
